title.narrative: Mainstreaming gender equality in Southeast Asia through the Transforming MENtalities framework

description.narrative: This workstream builds on best practices of the Social and Human Sciences Sector's programming to engage men and boys in gender equality in other countries and regions. Responding to the needs, priorities, and demand identified in the Southeast Asia SHS will build a follow-on/up programme, to strengthen a) knowledge on the behavioural, institutional, and structural factors which enable interventions to engage men and boys for gender equality to be successful; 2) the scale and reach of operational activities to engage men and boys for gender equality within educational and community settings; and 3) the networks available to encourage peer-learning, good practice sharing, and coordination around engaging men and boys for gender equality in areas of SHS mandate such as inter-cultural dialogue, ethics of science and technology and youth and sports for development.
